card.line: Ramath-lehi is the place Samson named after he struck down a thousand Philistines with a donkey's jawbone, and where God then gave him water.

moments.title: Samson names the place
moments.text: After Samson says he has killed a thousand men with a donkey's jawbone, he throws the jawbone away. He names the place Ramath-lehi.

moments.title: God gives water
moments.text: Samson is very thirsty and cries out to the LORD. God opens up a hollow place in Lehi, and water comes out. Samson drinks and his strength returns.
